text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believe was looking unwell, so I took her 
to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I'll be fine. Please go back 
to work, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Understood... Get plenty of rest, okay!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Where is this?

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAGH! GWAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
......Huh? A dinosaur... and a dragon? Are 
they fighting...?

text_block_list.name: Villager A
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Welcome to the world of swords and 
sorcery, MahoBre World!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...I don't really get it, but... It feels 
like this isn't an ordinary world...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Chipping away just a little yields stone. 
With that, I can craft a pickaxe...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...So the process... has been 
simplified...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I gathered this much ore in 10 hours. And 
making a simple house... was pretty fast 
too...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I might be able to do anything. In this 
world...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Finished.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(It took less than a week... to build an 
entire castle.)

text_block_list.name: Villager A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a giant castle...! Did you build this 
all by yourself? That's amazing, amazing!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Villager A
text_block_list.text:
"Still, with something this magnificent... 
the Lizard Gang might set their sights on 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it will be fine. I 
surrounded the castle with high-hardness 
minerals. It shouldn't get a single 
scratch.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I have business to attend to, 
so please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Next, I'd like to build an irrigation 
channel... There should be a river nearby. 
If we draw water from there—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(............Maybe it's the influence of 
that game I played with Right O and the 
others the other day.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......What a strange dream.
